duration.text: The Pharmacology at Shandong First Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Scanned copy of passport with a validity period of at least 18 months; for students from within China, a residence permit certificate for at least 30 days is required. (2) A valid health certificate issued by the designated local hospital for entry and exit, valid for no more than 6 months; (3) A criminal record certificate issued by the local police department, valid for no more than 6 months. (4) Highest educational qualification certificate / degree certificate; Note: If the applicant is a student or has already started employment, an additional document certifying the applicant's status as a student (such as a transfer certificate) or an employment certificate from the employer must be submitted. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be accompanied by a notarized translation in either Chinese or English. (5) Applicants are required to provide a transcript showing a total score of B grade (with a score ranging from 60% to 70%) or above in the high school graduation examination, a transcript showing an English subject score of more than 65% of the full score, or an IELTS score of 6.5; for applications for Chinese-taught programs, a transcript showing successful completion of the National or our university's "International Chinese Proficiency Standard" Level 4 examination is also required; for non-Chinese or non-English versions, a notarized Chinese or English translation must be attached. (6) Economic proof materials: A deposit certificate of at least $20,000 of equivalent value; (7) Self-introduction Video: A self-introduction video lasting at least 1 minute, in English; (8) Scanned copies of the identification documents of the economic guarantor and the person in charge of the matter in China; (9) For those applying for postgraduate studies, the following additional materials are required: undergraduate/master's degree transcripts, resumes in both Chinese and English, personal statements, and expert recommendation letters.

requirements.text: (1) Non-Chinese citizens holding valid ordinary passports of a foreign country; (2) In good health, aged between 18 and 25; for those applying for a master's degree, the age should generally not exceed 30. (3) No criminal record, and agree to abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China and the relevant management rules of our university; (4) To apply for the undergraduate program, one must have a high school diploma or higher education; to apply for the postgraduate program, one must have a bachelor's degree or higher.
